name: Yawgmoth
description: Yawgmoth was a Thran healer and eugenicist who became the god and progenitor of the Phyrexians, the main antagonist of the Invasion saga.

summary.text: Yawgmoth was a Thran healer and eugenicist who became the god and progenitor of the Phyrexians, the main antagonist of the Invasion saga.

bio.text: Exiled after the Thran Civil War, Yawgmoth committed atrocities across Dominaria, including turning the Creeping Mold of Argoth into a plague against the elves.

citations.text: "Thran Empire", section "Early History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Rebbec had him recalled to cure Glacian's phthisis, and he quelled Gix's rebellion with free serum and joined the council.

citations.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Yawgmoth", section "Rise to Power". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: He talked the planeswalker Dyfed into finding a plane for his paradise, and when she opened a portal he bound himself to the plane's core, became a god and named it Phyrexia.

"Yawgmoth", section "Thran-Phyrexian War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: He overthrew the Thran council, slaughtered the Halcites for parts, won at Megheddon Defile with the Null Sphere and bombed the remaining Thran cities with death clouds.

citations.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Thran-Phyrexian War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Rebbec sealed the portal and locked him out of Dominaria for millennia, while he turned the Thran refugees into the first true Phyrexians.

bio.text: When Urza and Mishra disturbed the powerstone seal he sent Gix through to manipulate their war, and he later invaded Urza's mind when Urza attacked Phyrexia.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth turns the Creeping Mold of Argoth into a plague that eats away the elves.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth turned the Creeping Mold of Argoth into a virulent plague that ate away the elves there.

citation.text: "Elf", section "Terisiaran Elves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth kidnaps the priestess Elyssendril and her healers and extorts the elves.
timeline.quote: When the elves paid, he delivered only sweetened water and 12 dead healers to them.

citation.text: "Elf", section "Terisiaran Elves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elyssendril is sent as a delegate to Halcyon against Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: Elyssendril survived and was later part of the delegates sent to Halcyon on behalf of the Thran Alliance against Yawgmoth.

citation.text: "Elf", section "Terisiaran Elves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth cures phthisis and coerces an oath of loyalty from Gix, pacifying his rebellion.
timeline.quote: vowed to serve Yawgmoth faithfully forever

citation.text: "Gix", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Phyrexia's founding, Gix is among the first compleated and becomes Yawgmoth's right-hand man in the Thran-Phyrexian War.
timeline.quote: Gix became one of the first living beings to be Compleat ed

citation.text: "Gix", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rebbec recombines the stones to close the portal and seals Yawgmoth in Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: his wife Rebbec discovered Yawgmoth's evil nature and recombined the two halves to close the portal Dyfed had created, sealing him in Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Mightstone and Weakstone", section "The Thran". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During Apocalypse Urza meets a tormented body of Mishra deep in Phyrexia, whose nature is uncertain.
timeline.quote: he met the body of Mishra deep in the Center of Phyrexia

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Death and afterlife". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xantcha is sent to the First Sphere to be taught how to survive on her target plane; she begins to think for herself.
timeline.quote: she thought for herself.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Creation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Shard of Twelve Worlds closes Phyrexia off from Dominaria, and Yawgmoth harshly punishes Gix as Xantcha watches.
timeline.quote: For this oversight, Gix was harshly punished by Yawgmoth with a grand display that Xantcha personally observed.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Creation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth halts Urza and assaults his mind; Xantcha gets her life matrix, shakes Urza from his stupor and he planeswalks them away.
timeline.quote: he planeswalked them away to safety.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Travel with Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza attacks Phyrexia but is defeated and corrupted by Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: Urza launches an attack on Phyrexia , but is defeated.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Ice Age (450 AR to 2934 AR) [ 17 ] [ 53 ] [ 50 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sisay sets out to gather the Legacy, knowing only that it can kill the Lord of the Wastes, Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: Sisay set out to gather the Legacy.

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The ship is destroyed by the Primeval Crosis and reborn as a sentient being, then destroyed a final time over Urborg.
timeline.quote: The ship was destroyed by the Primeval Crosis , only to be reborn as a completely sentient being.

citation.text: "Skyship Weatherlight", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth sits poised to invade Dominaria four thousand years after Urza and Mishra reopened the portal to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: the evil lord Yawgmoth sits poised to invade his one-time home

citation.text: "Weatherlight", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard must face his blood brother Vuel, who as Volrath became Yawgmoth's first in command.
timeline.quote: becoming Yawgmoth's first in command

citation.text: "Weatherlight", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth orders the construction of the artificial plane Rath from flowstone as a staging point.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth ordered the construction of the artificial plane of Rath through the use of a newly created substance called flowstone

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth is said to have created Rath after the fall of the Shard.
timeline.quote: It was said to be created by Yawgmoth , sometime after the fall of the Shard .

citation.text: "Rath", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth orders Rath used to store troops and plan the attack on Dominaria, hidden in a pocket plane.

citation.text: "Rath", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vuel is transported to Rath through Starke's portal, gives himself to Phyrexia, and becomes Volrath, evincar of Rath.
timeline.quote: he gave himself to Phyrexia , becoming Volrath, the new evincar of Rath, a shapeshifter and master of flowstone manipulation.

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth creates the artificial plane of Rath to prepare a full invasion of Dominaria.
timeline.quote: He started to amass an army and created the artificial plane of Rath

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Lord of the Wastes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Croag discovers Urza's Bloodline project and Yawgmoth raids Dominaria to kill the results, but Gerrard slips through.
timeline.quote: Urza had started the Bloodline project

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Lord of the Wastes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax is taken to Phyrexia, where Kirril compleats him into a Phyrexian and he is groomed as evincar of Rath.
timeline.quote: he was to become the new evincar of Rath, needing only to prove himself to his masters before he could take the throne.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Dark rebirth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth brushes Urza's mind and Urza's world convulses.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth brushed Urza's mind, and Urza's world convulsed.

citation.text: Corrupt (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Xantcha warns Urza that Phyrexians in human skin are everywhere.
timeline.quote: They are the sleeper agents, and they are everywhere.

citation.text: Darkest Hour (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bo Levar gives his essence to shield the Eliterates from Yawgmoth's Black Cloud of Death and dies.
timeline.quote: He gave his life in appreciation of beauty

citation.text: "Bo Levar", section "Nine Titans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth usurps the Thran Empire, leading to civil war and the empire's collapse.
timeline.quote: However, a man named Yawgmoth managed to usurp most of the power in the empire, which led to both civil war and war

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Thran Empire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rebbec seals the portal to Phyrexia, locking Yawgmoth out for millennia as Halcyon falls.
timeline.quote: Rebbec managed to seal the portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia, locking Yawgmoth out for millennia.

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Thran Empire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth corrupts the dragon engines.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth corrupted them

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Dragon engines". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth's wrath falls on Gix after the rift cuts Phyrexia off, and Gix is cast into the Punishment Sphere.
timeline.quote: cast down into Phyrexia's Punishment Sphere to be tortured indefinitely

citation.text: "Gix", section "Sleeper agents". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth is brought to Phyrexia by the planeswalker Dyfed, long before the Invasion.
timeline.quote: Phyrexia was not so different from Mirrodin until Yawgmoth arrived thousands of years ago, brought there by the planeswalker Dyfed.

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "Yawgmoth's refuge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth and the Thran exiles, saved through Phyresis, flee to Phyrexia after being forced out of the Thran Empire; the war destroys the Thran.
timeline.quote: The ensuing war destroyed the nation of the Thran.

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "Yawgmoth's refuge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza and Mishra take the powerstone, accidentally reopening the portal to Phyrexia, and Yawgmoth sends Gix to scout.
timeline.quote: Seeing his opportunity, Yawgmoth sent through the Phyrexian demon

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza and Xantcha assault Phyrexia, blasting a hole to the Fourth Sphere before being driven off by Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: Urza blasted a giant hole in the plane down to the Fourth Sphere

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "The return of Gix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth destroys the Thran empire.
timeline.quote: The empire was ultimately destroyed by Yawgmoth , ruler of Phyrexia .

citation.text: "Terisiare", section "The Thran". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza realizes Gix corrupted Mishra, beginning his lifelong hunt for retribution against Phyrexia and Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: Urza came to realize that Mishra had been completely corrupted by Gix

citation.text: "Urza", section "Exploring the Origins of Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza attacks Phyrexia, blasts a hole down to the 4th Sphere, but Yawgmoth invades his mind and drives him further insane.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth himself invaded his mind and made him go even more insane

citation.text: "Urza", section "Exploring the Origins of Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Null Moon plan fails; Urza reveals the final secret and the Legacy Weapon is fired using Urza's stones, Karn's body and Gerrard's life, killing Urza and Gerrard and destroying Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: Urza and Gerrard died in the activation, but the weapon successfully destroyed Yawgmoth.

citation.text: "The Legacy", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza secretly starts the Bloodline Project to create mortal heroes to wield the Legacy against Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: Urza also secretly started the Bloodline Project

citation.text: "Tolaria", section "Bloodline Project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza creates the Metathran to resist the Rath overlay and Yawgmoth's coming invasion.
timeline.quote: Urza constructed an army of sorcery and power to resist the coming invasion.

citation.text: "Urza", section "Bloodlines and Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Godwyn is captured by Phyrexians, compleated, and leads a conquest of New Argive until Kari betrays and kills him.
timeline.quote: until he is betrayed and killed by his second-in-command, the Compleated woman Kari .

citation.text: "The Myths of Magic", section "Phyrexian Creations by J. Robert King". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The planeswalker Dyfed brings upper-class Thran from Halcyon to Mercadia to keep them safe from Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: brought to Mercadia by the planeswalker Dyfed in an act of compassion

citation.text: "Mercadia", section "Inhabitants". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Phyrexia, Abcal-dro reconstructs Avila's body as a cyborg, names her Belbe and implants the Eye of Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: A black sphere was then implanted in her body

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Belbe grows disillusioned with Phyrexia, disables the Eye of Yawgmoth, and falls in love with Ertai.
timeline.quote: She disabled the Eye of Yawgmoth implanted in her

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Rathi Overlay, Crovax oversees Phyrexian domination of Urborg, executes Tsabo Tavoc, and convinces Gerrard to submit to Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: This convinced Gerrard to surrender himself to the Dark Lord.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Reign of Terror". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aided by the Weatherlight crew, Gerrard sacrifices his life to activate the Legacy Weapon, defeating Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: Gerrard Capashen sacrificed his life to activate the Legacy Weapon

citation.text: "Bloodline Project", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth travels through the portal as a death cloud, killing billions.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth himself had traveled through the portal in the form of a giant death cloud, killing more people in mere minutes than the entire war had in a year.

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "First Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Powerless against Yawgmoth, Freyalise returns to Skyshroud.
timeline.quote: Powerless against the Lord of the Wastes, Freyalise returned to Skyshroud

citation.text: "Freyalise", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Legacy Weapon saves Dominaria and seemingly destroys Yawgmoth; only Freyalise and Windgrace of the Nine survive.
timeline.quote: Freyalise, along with all of Dominaria, was saved by the activation of the Legacy Weapon, which seemingly destroyed Yawgmoth.

citation.text: "Freyalise", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax, now evincar, takes Gerrard to Phyrexia where Gerrard pledges loyalty to Yawgmoth in hope of Hanna's return.
timeline.quote: where he pledged his loyalty to Yawgmoth, who promised he could bring Hanna back from the dead.

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard decapitates the powerless Urza in a fight set by Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: Robbed of his powers as a planeswalker within the Ninth Sphere, Urza could not best the skill of Gerrard and was decapitated.

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth enters Dominaria as a gigantic Black Cloud of Death.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth himself entered Dominaria in the form of a gigantic Black Cloud of Death

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth tempts Gerrard with a false promise to revive Hanna.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth later tempted Gerrard with the promise of bringing his beloved back to life, but that was only an elaborate ruse.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard places Urza's powerstone eyes into Karn; the Legacy destroys the Phyrexians and Yawgmoth, and Karn becomes the first artificial planeswalker.
timeline.quote: the powerstones turned Karn into the first artificial planeswalker

citation.text: "Karn", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Thaw, Yawgmoth comes through the portal to invade Dominaria, but the Weatherlight seals it again.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth came through to invade Dominaria , but the Weatherlight sealed it again.

citation.text: "Koilos", section "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza is convinced to kill Taysir, then is taken to see Mishra in the Seventh Sphere and brought to worship Yawgmoth in the Ninth.
timeline.quote: Next, he went to the Ninth Sphere to worship Yawgmoth himself, along with Gerrard.

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "Counter attack and betrayal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth strips Urza of his planeswalker powers and forces him to fight Gerrard; Gerrard beheads Urza.
timeline.quote: Gerrard managed to land a strike that beheaded Urza

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "Urza vs. Gerrard". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth returns to Dominaria; after the Weatherlight shoots down the Null Moon, the Legacy Weapon destroys him and the Phyrexian forces lose their will to live.
timeline.quote: Phyrexian forces lost all will to live with the death of their god.

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "Yawgmoth vs. The Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth, a Thran eugenicist, takes over an idyllic world with Dyfed's help and brings his followers there, creating the first Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: he brought his followers to this new world, the first Phyrexia

citation.text: "Phyrexian", section "Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth begins the invasion of Dominaria in 4205 AR after millennia of planning.
timeline.quote: began in 4205 AR after millennia of planning by the dark god Yawgmoth

timeline.summary: The Nine Titans counterattack Phyrexia directly; several are killed and Urza defects to Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: Urza defected to the side of Yawgmoth

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Second stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth makes Gerrard and Urza duel; Gerrard decapitates Urza and discovers the Hanna he fought for was Yawgmoth in disguise.
timeline.quote: the duel ended with Gerrard decapitating Urza

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Final stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.quote: He appeared as a black cloud of death and reanimated every dead thing on the plane

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Final stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Legacy is completed by the sacrifice of Urza, Gerrard and Karn, destroying Yawgmoth's essence and ending the invasion.
timeline.quote: the Legacy was completed through the sacrifice of Urza , Gerrard Capashen , and Karn

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Final stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard, Urza and Karn merge to complete the Legacy, defeating Yawgmoth; Weatherlight sinks near Urborg, leaving Sisay without a ship.
timeline.quote: leaving Sisay adrift without a ship to captain

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth hacks at Yawgmoth's tentacles, buying time for Gerrard, Urza and Karn to complete the Legacy and destroy Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: This brave defiance bought Gerrard, Urza, and Karn enough time to complete the Legacy and destroy Yawgmoth.

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard decapitates Urza and wounds Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: Gerrard battles and decapitates Urza, then wounds Yawgmoth

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth is slain by the combined power of the Legacy and Karn ascends.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth is slain by the combined power of The Legacy.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Phyrexian Invasion (4205 AR to 4206 AR) [ 16 ] [ 10 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Multani transplants part of Yavimaya to Urborg's edge for the last great battle, in whose skies Yawgmoth is finally defeated.
timeline.quote: It was in the skies over Urborg that Yawgmoth was finally defeated

citation.text: "Urborg", section "First Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dominaria's forces unite to push Yawgmoth back during the Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: All of the forces of Dominaria banded against Yawgmoth and tried to push him back.

citation.text: "Urza", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth launches his full-scale invasion of Dominaria in 4205 AR.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth finally launched his full-scale invasion of Dominaria in 4205 AR.

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth becomes convinced his true foe is Rebbec's spirit as the worldsoul Gaea.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth became convinced that his ultimate foe was not Urza

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
